name: Mixedbread mxbai-rerank-large-v2
attention_variant: cross-encoder (Qwen2 causal decoder), full attention over query+passage
notes: RERANKER: cross-encoder using a Qwen2 causal decoder backbone (hidden 1536, 28 layers, 12 heads, 2 KV heads, vocab 151936, 32768 max_position_embeddings). KV cache applies (28 * 2 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 28672 bytes/token at bf16) but is irrelevant for reranking (single forward pass per pair). 1.776B params, 3.55e9 flops/token — GPU-class work. Apache-2.0. GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
